title: Benchmark Dataset Manifest v0.1
description: Turn P6: summarizes a loaded set of DatasetRecords (dataset-record.schema.json) BEFORE any Agent execution -- pins dataset_sha256, per-split counts, and the result of the split/chain-leakage check (domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/dataset.mjs's checkSplitLeakage). A Benchmark Runner refuses to execute against a manifest whose leakage_check.violations is non-empty, or whose holdout_gate.unlocked is false while holdout_item_count > 0.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonicalized (evaluation_item_id, question, split) list of every item actually loaded -- see domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/dataset.mjs's computeDatasetItemsSha256.

checked.description: Always true for any manifest this module produces -- there is no code path that skips the leakage check.

unlocked.description: true only when a caller-supplied HOLDOUT unlock (domain/runtime/evaluation-usage-ledger.mjs's canUseSplit, re-used unmodified) actually returned ok:true for every HOLDOUT item in this dataset. false (the fail-closed default) means any HOLDOUT rows present were rejected at load time -- this manifest is never produced for a dataset containing HOLDOUT rows that failed the gate; the load itself throws instead (see dataset.mjs).

unlock_run_purpose.description: The run_purpose the unlock token was granted under (domain/contracts.mjs's RUN_PURPOSES), or null when holdout_item_count is 0.

grading_policy_versions.description: Every distinct DatasetRecord.grading_policy_version present in this dataset.
